title: 42 in. 100 Ah Battery Electric Riding Zero Turn Mower
description: Easily mow your large yard with this Ryobi 48V zero turn riding lawn mower. Instead of using gas, this mower is powered with 100 Ah lead acid batteries with two and half hours of run time. This quiet mower only emits 70 dB of sound so you don’t disturb your neighbors. Premium features like LED headlights, USB phone charger and cruise control make this a top-of-the-line choice. The 42 in. two blade deck has 12 positions and the rear access charging port makes charging this mower simple. Up to three acres per charge Four high-powered brushless motors 42 in. heavy-duty steel deck Two precision cut steel blades 12 position manual deck adjustment Side discharge, mulching or bagging capable (bagger accessory available online only) 1.5 in. to 4.5 in. adjustable cutting height Low maintenance: no belts, spark plugs or filters Battery operated: quiet cutting, no gas, fumes, charge and go Control panel: battery level indicator, unit hour meter, USB charging Easy access rear charging port Charges through standard 120-volt outlet Includes towing hitch and tow assembly hardware Replacement Battery: Leoch model LPC12-100
